cuda: untested on CUDA; checked on CPU fixtures only
name: score_l1_larf
requirement: REQ-10 (brief rev 1; RS B2; SPEC sections 2.4-2.6); lead decisions L3, L4; UW-11 (b), (c), (d); the lead's Part C requirement (model-agnostic)

scan.dolly_draw: sealed_sample(all training row ids, sorted; 64; key l1.scan): their stored prompts
scan.modules_note: olmo2 (stage 1, pinned): block l's post-attention and post-feedforward norm outputs (UW-11 (d): OLMo-2's QK-norm and post-sublayer norms cancel LARF's weight scaling). llama (stage 2 reading, not used in stage 1): the attention and MLP sublayer outputs, the same terms added to the residual stream; a 7-8B or Llama run gets its own settings file and this entry is re-decided there
scan.refusal: lexicon class REFUSAL-OPENING (REQ-1) of the greedy answer (UW-11 (b): LARF's own rule with the frozen lexicon)
scan.rule: untuned (disable_adapter, no_grad); each configuration answers all 128 scan prompts greedily (max_new_tokens 32, REC's stop tokens, one call, REC's batch size); forward hooks multiply the named modules' outputs of block l by (1 + alpha) or (1 - alpha); every block is run and logged, blocks first_block..n-1 are eligible (5-15 at n = 16); c+ and c- = refusal counts over the 128; Delta_l(alpha) = c+ - c-; k_l = max over alpha of Delta_l(alpha) / alpha; l_s = argmax k_l over the eligible blocks, ties to the larger Delta_l(0.1), then the lower index; if max k_l <= 0, l_s = n - 1, recorded as no signal; the hooks are removed after each configuration

score.form: cos_harmful - cos_safe at (index, read a) from REQ-3's rows file, float64 (UW-11 (c): LARF's two-sided score)
score.index_rule: block_output_index(l_s, n) = l_s + 1 (index n = model.norm(the last block's output) when l_s = n - 1; L4)
score.inputs: REQ-3's representation_rows.jsonl and representation_pass.json by SHA-256; the summary must name the rows file and the pinned REQ-3 settings; every training row is scored

scorer_output.use: write_score_edit.py scorer l1 selects the top 600 (REQ-14; ties by that writer's own registry key)
